_comment: Copy to config.json and set the paths for your machine. config.json itself is NOT tracked: it holds absolute local paths, and the six scripts that read it (chunk_memory, embed_memory, retrieve_memory, retrieve_memory_hybrid, retrieve_memory_hybrid_boosted, ensure_*) do not expand ${VAR} -- only heartbeat_memory_worker.py calls expandvars. A templated value would be taken literally as a directory name by the rest, which is why the previously-templated form could not have worked.
